stickyLayout.name: reTerminal Sticky
stickyLayout.description: Made for the Seeed reTerminal Sticky. The scene fills the glass. The scene list becomes a home screen with the time, the date, the battery and the signal, and a tab beside each key saying what a press and a hold do. Swipe up for the list and down for the settings. Double-press AI for the list. Or pick a rail of buttons beside the keys, or a status bar.
